text: Patented Solid State Electrochemical Hydrogen Sensor with Solid Electrolyte and Novel Reference Electrode.
High Sensitivity to Minute Leaks – 10 ppm
Audio & Visual Perception of H2 Leaks
Smart Algorithms for User Friendly Interactions
USB C-Type for Charging & Data Transfer
Enhanced Safety: User can pin-point very low levels of leak at very early stages and act proactively to fix the leaks.
Enhanced Operator Efficiency: Checking leaks takes 10X less time compared to traditional H2 leak detectors, due to sub-second response and recovery time.
Design Advantage: Small and easy to handle. Extended and flexible probe design enables insertion of the probe into high or small and space constrained locations.
No Damage on Over-Exposure: Sensor can be taken as close to the leak source as needed, without worrying about sensor damage.
Saves operational cost: No false alarms avoiding unnecessary down time.
Comprehensive AMC: Periodic calibration and cashless product replacement even beyond warranty period.
Product Upgrade Plans: Buy back options to upgrade your safety systems with our latest and best in class offerings.
